title: Biased Majority Error Above Half
statement: Fix $p\in(1/2,1)$. For each odd number $2m+1$ of independent signs, with each sign equal to $-1$ with probability $p$, the probability that their majority is $-1$ tends to $1$ as $m\to\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: The number of signs is $2m+1$ for $m$ tending to infinity
The signs are independent and each is $-1$ with probability $p$
